articles.summary: Frontier Airlines, Inc., a subsidiary of Frontier Group Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: ULCC), today announced the appointment of Michael Delehant as Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, effective November 30, 2026. The company also announced several other changes to its leadership team. In his new role, Delehant will oversee all aspects of operations and report to Frontier CEO Jimmy Dempsey. Delehant brings deep airline leadership experience to the role, most recently serving as Group Managing Director of Wizz Air, where he oversaw the airline's operational and commercial activities. His experience also includes senior leadership roles at Vueling, a Spanish low-cost carrier, where he most recently served as Chief Strategy and Network Officer, as well as a series of leadership positions at Southwest Airlines. articles.title: Frontier Airlines Announces Leadership Changes, Including Appointment of Michael Delehant to Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer
